_comment: Every @font-face weight origin/main declares, per family, captured from
site/assets/fonts/fonts.css. This is what decides which font INSTANCE a given
font-weight actually renders as: a weight with no declared face falls back to
the nearest declared one. Assistant tops out at 600, which is why every
font-weight:700/800/bold across the site renders at 600.
tests/e2e/bold-weight-no-leak.spec.js uses this table to re-derive, in the
browser, the instance origin/main would have given each bold element, and
asserts the page still renders exactly that. Regenerate with:
node scripts/… no script — see the spec's footer comment.
